form.p: Fills this database with a regional cloud seeding operator and its last 150 days of operations:

ul.li: five bases, seven crewed aircraft and three drones (the King Air 350 is close to its service interval), and 14 pilots and drone operators;
hygroscopic and glaciogenic flares, two vendors, a reorder rule per base and flare, and the purchases, batch receipts, and paid bills they led to;
scheduled services, breakdowns, observed rainfall for missions flown more than two weeks ago, client summaries to review, and the invoices and payments of past months.

form.p: Loading fetches the weather history of every area and takes about two minutes. Without internet access, a smaller history is built from recorded snapshots, without cloud alerts. The company is renamed Stratus Ridge Weather Services. Dates are set relative to today.
